layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive Deinocheirus with clean high-poly clay geometry is standing calmly in the shallow water channel of a Late Cretaceous river valley. The camera captures a stable three-quarter profile view at a neutral eye-level vantage point, dramatically highlighting the signature horizontal depth of its duck-billed snout, its colossal forearm claws hanging naturally, and its high muscular back hump without any active foraging mess or cartoonish over-rounding. It is looking forward with quiet curiosity near a sandbar bank dotted with stylized early hardwoods under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
